portal_hypertension.title: Endovascular management of extrahepatic portal vein obstruction (EHPVO): expanding beyond surgical shunts.
portal_hypertension.authors: Patel RK, Tripathy T, Sasidharan R
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：肝外门静脉阻塞（EHPVO）是非肝硬化门静脉高压的主要原因，特别是在儿童和年轻人中。 临床提示：传统上，明确的治疗依赖于外科分流术，例如近端脾肾分流术和 meso-Rex 旁路术。然而，广泛的门肠系膜血栓形成、不利的解剖结构、围手术期发病率和限制
portal_hypertension.abstract: Extrahepatic portal vein obstruction (EHPVO) is a major cause of noncirrhotic portal hypertension, particularly in children and young adults. Traditionally, definitive management relied on surgical shunts such as proximal splenorenal shunt and meso-Rex bypass; however, extensive porto-mesenteric thrombosis, unfavorable anatomy, perioperative morbidity, and limited surgical expertise may restrict surgical feasibility in many patients. Over the last decade, advances in interventional radiology have substantially expanded therapeutic options beyond surgery. portal_hypertension.title: A case of portal hypertension associated with a giant hepatic arterioportal fistula successfully treated with partial hepatic arterial embolization.
portal_hypertension.authors: Ueno M, Ojiro K, Nakadai Y
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：影像学检查显示肝内 HAPF 在门静脉后段分支与右肝动脉和右膈下动脉的动脉流入之间存在多处异常交通，导致诊断为 临床提示：影像学研究显示肝内 HAPF，门静脉后段分支与右肝动脉和右下膈的动脉流入之间存在多处异常交通
portal_hypertension.abstract: Adult-onset symptomatic hepatic arterioportal fistula (HAPF) is a rare vascular abnormality for which optimal treatment strategies have not been established. We report a case of a symptomatic giant HAPF successfully treated with interventional radiology. A woman in her 60 s presented with massive ascites. Imaging studies revealed an intrahepatic HAPF with multiple abnormal communications between the posterior segmental branch of the portal vein and arterial inflow from the right hepatic artery and the right inferior phrenic artery, leading to a diagnosis of portal hypertension associated with HAPF.
